subject: Map: Load test scheduling + traffic replay (next steps & dates)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintechco.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@fintechco.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Load test scheduling + traffic replay (post-call recap)

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and the MAP milestone we discussed (load/perf test scheduling):

- Objective: run a traffic replay to validate peak QPS and end-to-end latency on Redwood Dedicated before go-live.
- Target peak: 1,200 QPS sustained for 20 minutes with 95th pct < 250ms on inference tokens.
- Scope: replay production traffic (anonymized) for two representative endpoints (chat generation + embeddings).
- Success criteria: pass load profile without >2% error-rate and latency SLOs met.

Next steps / owners (MAP draft items):
1) FinTechCo: confirm replay window and provide a sanitized traffic dump (CSV or ndjson) — owner: Samantha — due: 2026-07-20
2) Redwood: produce traffic-replay config and test token; size Dedicated capacity and confirm node count — owner: Aditya — due: 2026-07-19
3) FinTechCo + Redwood: agree on replay IP allowlist / VPN or temporary peering, and redaction checklist — owner: Tom / Vivek — due: 2026-07-18
4) Redwood: run smoke run on staging, then run full replay during agreed window; produce post-test report — owner: Neha — target run date: 2026-07-21

Attachments: I attached a one-page MAP milestone CSV with the dates and a preliminary traffic-replay-config.json. Aditya — I've flagged where we need a recommended Dedicated sizing (gpus / instance family) based on the 1,200 QPS target.

Please confirm owners/dates or propose adjustments. Once we lock the window I'll send the test token and allowlist details.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0128

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintechco.com>

Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Load test scheduling + traffic replay (post-call recap)

Thanks Marissa — this looks good and aligns with our internal expectations. A couple of notes/questions: 

- We can get a sanitized traffic dump ready by EOD Mon (2026-07-20). We'll remove PII and any payment tokens per our redaction checklist.
- Replay window: Can we target Tue 2026-07-21 10:00–11:00 PDT for the full run?
- One ask: can Redwood include a small ramp-up run the day prior (Mon 07/20) to validate the config? We prefer that to avoid surprises during the full run.

Tom and I will coordinate on network access — we'll likely prefer a temporary peering/VPN rather than opening inbound to our prod IPs.

Confirming owners: Samantha (FinTechCo) will deliver sanitized dump by 07/20; Marissa / Redwood to confirm test token and sizing.

Appreciate it —
Samantha Lee
Head of Payments Platform, FinTechCo
samantha.lee@fintechco.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Load test scheduling + traffic replay (post-call recap)

Thanks for the recap, Marissa. Quick sizing note based on the 1,200 QPS target and our internal benchmarks:

- Preliminary recommendation: 4 x A100-similar GPUs (or 6 x T4-equivalent) behind our batching runtime to reliably hit 1.2k QPS with cache misses. We’ll propose an instance mix in the final estimate.
- Will prepare traffic-replay-config.json tweaks (payload sizing, concurrency, header replication) and the test token by Mon 07/19 EOD.
- Agree with a smoke ramp on Mon 07/20 (15–30 min) then full replay on Tue 07/21.

Dependencies / blockers:
- Need the sanitized dump from FinTechCo (Samantha) and a temporary network arrangement for egress/backhaul.
- If the test includes real-time upstream calls (billing, third-party enrichments), we’ll need stubs or allow Redwood to intercept those to avoid contacting external partners.

I'll attach a short checklist in the Drive link and copy the MAP CSV with the recommended node counts.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Marissa / Aditya —

Confirmed: sanitized dump will be uploaded to the shared Drive folder by EOD today (2026-07-20). We'll provide a redaction report with the dataset.

Network: IT prefers temporary VPN peering. I'll open the ticket now and loop in security to confirm the IP ranges. Expect a note with connection details by lunchtime today.

Ramp-up ok for Mon 07/20 (we'll aim for 16:00 PDT) — please confirm a 30-min window and a single node smoke run, then full run 07/21 10:00 PDT.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Load test scheduling + traffic replay (post-call recap)

All — thanks for the quick turnaround. Final confirmations: 

- Redwood will deliver the test token (redwood-test-token.txt) and traffic-replay-config.json by EOD Mon 07/19 (Aditya delivered these on time; token attached).
- Smoke ramp: Mon 07/20 16:00–16:30 PDT — Redwood will run single-node smoke and validate connectivity. Owner: Neha.
- Full replay: Tue 07/21 10:00–11:00 PDT — Redwood will run against Dedicated sizing of 4 x A100-similar GPUs (provisioned by Redwood Dedicated) with autoscale disabled for the window. Owner: Aditya/Neha.
- Post-test: Redwood will share a report within 48 hours including QPS, latency percentiles, error breakdown, and any capacity recommendations.

Open items:
- FinTechCo to confirm VPN peer details and upload sanitized dump (Samantha).
- FinTechCo & Redwood to agree on whether to stub external third-party calls (Tom / Aditya).

If that matches, I'll update the MAP CSV and mark the milestone as Confirmed with target close date 2026-07-21.

Thanks — looking forward to the run.

Marissa
